title: actup configuration
description: Configuration file for actup, the GitHub Actions upgrader.

major.description: Global default target major version to upgrade actions to (e.g., 4).

actions.description: Per-action configuration mapping action names (e.g., 'actions/checkout') to specific versions or behaviors.

anyOf.description: Target major version (e.g., "4"), exact version (e.g., "v4.1.2", "master"), or "skip" to ignore this action.
